Wait, earlier test of probe pod gave 403 for /api/v1/namespaces/default/configmaps with a valid token too. Then decide fix: if 200 on cluster-wide endpoint without extra RBAC, then it's just the Role being namespaced but missing ClusterRole aggregation?
